name: synthetic biology
subtitle: from sterile bench to purified protein
author: neosynbio (curated)
description: A project-based wet-lab synthetic biology curriculum adapted from the open-source NeoSynBio Graduate's Guide, with the best-rated external guides (NEB, Addgene, Benchling, SnapGene, Thermo Fisher, Bio-Rad, iGEM) attached to every node.

nodes.title: welcome to the synbio skill tree
nodes.description: How to navigate this project-based synthetic biology curriculum and set up for success.

nodes.title: the sterile workspace
nodes.description: Set up PPE, a Bunsen 'cone of protection', and a media-sterilisation strategy.

nodes.title: host selection criteria
nodes.description: Choose a safe, well-characterised, single-celled host - and check it's legal.

nodes.title: culturing conditions
nodes.description: Know your organism: ideal media, temperature, growth curve and morphology.

nodes.title: diy buffer mixing
nodes.description: Mix your own buffers safely to cut costs - or buy pre-mixed if working solo.

nodes.title: mixing media & pouring plates
nodes.description: Mix LB media/agar, pour plates, and make antibiotic selection plates.

nodes.title: sterile (aseptic) technique
nodes.description: Master the core discipline of microbiology - plus the inoculating loop and spreader.

nodes.title: dna101 (theory)
nodes.description: Refresh DNA structure, base pairing and the interactions cloning relies on.

nodes.title: purification of genomic dna
nodes.description: Extract genomic DNA - and learn why you'll usually work with plasmids instead.

nodes.title: plasmids101 (theory)
nodes.description: Understand plasmids as the programmable 'add-ons' of the cell.

nodes.title: backbone selection (theory)
nodes.description: Choose the right plasmid backbone for your first experiments.

nodes.title: plasmid miniprep (ethanol lysis)
nodes.description: Purify plasmid DNA via the premier miniprep workflow: lyse, capture, wash, elute.

nodes.title: plasmid insertion (transformation)
nodes.description: Get DNA into cells: heat shock, electroporation, or gene guns.

nodes.title: agarose gel electrophoresis
nodes.description: Separate and size DNA fragments - your bread-and-butter readout.

nodes.title: gel illumination & photography
nodes.description: Capture publication-quality gel images with cheap kit and a smartphone.

nodes.title: gblock & insert design (theory)
nodes.description: Design the perfect synthetic insert - codon optimisation, tags, cut sites.

nodes.title: restriction enzyme digest
nodes.description: Cut plasmid and insert with restriction enzymes; plan with a sequence viewer.

nodes.title: ligation & troubleshooting
nodes.description: Glue DNA with T4 ligase and design the five control plates that save you weeks.

nodes.title: polymerase chain reaction (pcr)
nodes.description: Amplify any DNA region exponentially with a thermocycler and a master mix.

nodes.title: primer design
nodes.description: Design primer pairs that bind your template, not each other.

nodes.title: gradient pcr
nodes.description: Find the optimal annealing temperature in a single run.

nodes.title: flanking sequence addition
nodes.description: Add restriction sites or assembly overhangs via 5' primer overhangs.

nodes.title: confirmation of edits
nodes.description: Screen clones with patch plates, colony PCR and restriction-digest analysis.

nodes.title: sequencing prep & interpretation
nodes.description: Prepare samples for external (or in-house Nanopore) sequencing and read results.

nodes.title: gibson assembly
nodes.description: Scarless single-tube assembly of up to ~6 fragments via homologous overlaps.

nodes.title: golden gate assembly
nodes.description: Type IIS scarless assembly of 10+ ordered fragments in one tube.

nodes.title: site-directed mutagenesis
nodes.description: Introduce a precise point mutation via megaprimer or round-the-world PCR.

nodes.title: crispr / cas9
nodes.description: Target precise genomic edits with a Cas enzyme and a designed guide RNA.

nodes.title: proteins101 (theory)
nodes.description: Working knowledge of protein mechanics before producing them in the lab.

nodes.title: induction of protein expression
nodes.description: Trigger protein expression at the right growth phase using OD600.

nodes.title: cell lysis
nodes.description: Bust open cells to release your protein into cell slurry.

nodes.title: affinity tag purification
nodes.description: Recover tagged protein from cell slurry (His-tag / Ni-NTA, or Car9/silica).

nodes.title: sds-page
nodes.description: Size and quantify proteins on a denaturing polyacrylamide gel.

nodes.title: capstone: express & purify a protein
nodes.description: Demonstrate mastery end to end: design, build, confirm, express and purify a protein.

nodes.title: beyond the bench: rna, omics & bio-programming
nodes.description: The frontier: gene switches, omics, aptamers, mass spec and advanced biological programming.

nodes.title: the micropipette
nodes.description: Master the single most important tool in the lab: accurate, bubble-free pipetting.

nodes.title: the centrifuge
nodes.description: Pellet cells and clear lysates safely - the workhorse behind minipreps.

nodes.title: the thermocycler
nodes.description: Program the heating/cooling cycles that drive PCR.

nodes.title: the spectrophotometer
nodes.description: Measure OD600 to track cell growth and time induction.

nodes.title: western blot
nodes.description: Detect a specific protein by size + antibody after transferring an SDS-PAGE gel to a membrane.

nodes.title: elisa
nodes.description: Quantify a protein/antigen in solution with an antibody-based plate assay.

nodes.title: rna purification
nodes.description: Extract intact RNA while keeping ubiquitous RNases at bay.

nodes.title: rt-qpcr
nodes.description: Reverse-transcribe RNA to cDNA and quantify transcript levels in real time.
